title: Structured event-name rename compliance.review_unparseable -> review_unparsable breaks the stable telemetry contract
evidence: diff.patch: `-            "compliance.review_unparseable",` / `+            "compliance.review_unparsable",` ... develop's file (git show develop) line 179: `"compliance.review_unparseable",` ... project convention: 'these strings are a stable observable contract'
detail: Event names are queried in BigQuery/Sentry per the project convention; renaming silently orphans queries keyed on the old name after deploy, losing WARNING rows with no error. Not part of the #172 state-view fix.
recommended_fix: Keep the existing event name and only add the verdict stamp; a rename belongs in a dedicated change with query migration and test updates together.

title: Verdict-stamp producer path untested: tests seed STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT by hand, never assert the judge callbacks write it
evidence: tests/unit/test_gate_state_marshalling.py:164: `STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT: {"judge_kind": "boundary", "passed": True}` (seeded input; grep shows the key appears only in this file as fixture input) ... compliance_enforcement.py:284/359: `_stamp_review_verdict(` call sites in _emit_failed_review_rollup / _emit_review_telemetry — no test references these
detail: The stamp is the load-bearing independent witness per the briefing; if the callback write is removed or mis-keyed, all 16 new tests stay green while the production cross-check silently no-ops (finalize reads a never-written slot).
recommended_fix: Extend tests/unit/test_verification_compliance_judge.py to assert log_boundary/final_compliance_review write STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT with judge_kind/passed on both the clean and failed-rollup paths.

title: Docstring overclaims regression coverage: a single-line read revert is NOT caught (verified empirically); only the full pre-fix shape is
evidence: tests/unit/test_gate_state_marshalling.py:21-23: 'the live dict the write lands on. They fail if any gate read reverts to ctx.state — the regression guard the InMemory recorder harness cannot provide' ... empirical partial-revert probe: reverting only `ctx.state.get(...)` (keeping finalize_boundary_gate(ctx.session.state)) passes all four assertions of test_clean_verdict_does_not_fail_close
detail: Negative control verified the full revert IS caught (error written to ctx.state, assertion 1 fails). But a read-only revert is masked because finalize then re-reads the clean review off session state and returns. The docstring's 'fail if any gate read reverts' is overstated.
recommended_fix: Narrow the docstring to 'fail if the gate's reads and finalize calls revert to ctx.state', or add a fixture where finalize also cannot see the live review so a single-line revert is discriminated.
